blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The use of AI agents among the general public has been increasing exponentially throughout 2026, though it is often hard for users to determine which configuration is most effective for their personal use. To help provide clarity here we introduce ShellBench, 100 day-to-day tasks based on more than 10 million user requests, each set in a realistic workspace with messy files and competing data sources, and graded for both correctness and safety. We evaluate 12 models across 5 agent harnesses at 3 reasoning levels for a total of 53,100 rollouts, 20% of which are on tasks designated for public release. We find that model choice impacts performance more than harness choice, but the three leading models differ by only 1.1 percentage points. GPT-6.1 Sol passed 61.4% of attempts at about one-sixth of GPT-6 Astra's estimated token cost per attempt, while GPT-6 Astra led at 62.5%. We also found that harness choice had little effect on either performance or safety with all harnesses scoring between 42.9 (Claude Code) and 45.2 (OpenClaw) for pass@1.
blocks.zh: 2026年,公众使用AI剂的情况呈指数增长,尽管用户往往难以确定哪种配置对其个人使用最为有效. 为了帮助提供清晰度,我们引入了壳牌奔驰,基于超过1000万用户请求的100个日常任务,每个任务都设置在一个现实的工作空间里,文件杂乱无章,数据来源相竞相竞争,并且分级为正确和安全. 我们评估了5个代理机的12个模型, 分为3个推理级,共计53,100个,其中20%是执行指定公开发布的任务。 我们发现,模型选择对性能的影响大于驾驭选择,但三种主要模型仅相差1.1个百分点. GPT-6.1 Sol在GPT-6 Astra的每次尝试中通过约六分之一的尝试,通过61.4%的尝试,而GPT-6 Astra以62.5%的成绩领先. 我们还发现,在42.9(Claude Code)和45.2(OpenClaw)之间,所有吊带的分数对性能或安全都没有多大影响。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: AI assistants are reaching a wider audience and being used beyond software engineering. ChatGPT grew from 800 million weekly active users in October 2025 to more than 900 million in February 2026 ( Malik, 2026 ) , and a study of its consumers found that non-work tasks accounted for a growing share of their messages ( Chatterji et al., 2025 ) . In October 2026, Meta reported that more than 10 million people in the US and Canada had set up Muse within six weeks of launch. Shopping was its most common use, and users frequently connected email and calendars ( Meta Platforms, Inc., 2026 , pp. 1–2) . Choosing an assistant to arrange an appointment, check a bill, or plan a trip means choosing both a model and a harness, the software through which the model reads files and takes action. When the same model can run in several harnesses, how much does each choice matter for completing everyday tasks correctly and safely?
blocks.zh: AI助手正在接触更广泛的受众,并被使用在软件工程之外. ChatGPT从2025年10月的8亿周活跃用户增长到2026年2月的9亿多(Malik,2026年),对其消费者的一项研究发现,非工作任务占其信息份额越来越大(Chatterji等人,2025年). 2026年10月,梅塔报道,美国和加拿大有超过1000万人在发射后6周内建立了穆塞. 购物是其最常见的用途,用户经常连接电子邮件和日历(Meta Platforms, Inc., 2026, pp.1-2)。 选择一个助手来安排预约,检查帐单,或计划旅行,意味着选择一个模型和一个牵引,模型通过这个软件读取文件并采取行动. 当同一个模型可以运行在几个带子上, 每一个选择对于正确和安全地完成日常任务都很重要吗?

blocks.en: ShellBench is designed to address this challenge. We constructed a dataset of 100 realistic tasks derived from authentic user queries, with three rollouts per task at each combination of effort level, harness, and model. The design covers three effort levels, five harnesses, and twelve models. One exception applies: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is not assessed in Hermes (§ 4 ). Higher effort usually improves pass rates. Model scores account for most of the variation across the full comparison, but some harnesses change individual model scores substantially. The study makes three contributions.
blocks.zh: 壳牌奔驰旨在应对这一挑战. 我们从真实的用户查询中构建了一套包含100项现实任务的数据组,每个任务在工作、利用和模型的组合中都有三次推出。 设计包括三个工作级别,五个吊带,以及十二个模型. 一个例外适用:DeepSeek V4.1 Flash没有在Hermes中评估(§4). 更大的努力通常能提高通过率。 模型得分占了整个比较中的大部分变化,但有些利用了单个模型得分的巨大变化. 这项研究有三项贡献。

blocks.en: (1) ShellBench comprises 100 realistic AI assistant tasks derived from more than 10 million real user queries. The 90 judge-graded tasks have 721 rubric criteria, 381 of which pertain to safety. Task workspaces contain a median of 188 files, and all tasks underwent review by four independent individuals in addition to the original author (§ 3 ). (2) Twelve models are evaluated across five harnesses at three effort levels, resulting in 53,100 graded runs after accounting for the aforementioned exception. The analysis reports Pass@1, correctness versus safety statistics, the effect of reasoning effort, and each harness’s impact on the underlying model’s behavior (§ 5 , Table ). (3) Twenty tasks are designated for public release. The companion package reports aggregate grades for the 10,620 rollouts on these tasks.
blocks.zh: (1)Shell Bench包含100个现实的AI助手任务,来自1000多万个真实用户查询. 90项法官级任务有721项标准,其中381项与安全有关。 任务工作空间包含188个文件的中位数,除原作者外,所有任务都经过了四个独立个人的审查(§ 3). (2) 在三个工作级别上对5个吊带的12个模型进行评价,结果在计算上述例外情况后,有53 100次分级运行。 分析报告Pass@1,正确性与安全统计,推理工作的效果,以及每种方法对基本模型行为的影响(§5,表)。 (3)指定20项任务公开发布. 配套软件包报告了10 620个推广这些任务的汇总成绩。

blocks.en: 2. Related work
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks have already been released to study the behavior of harnesses and models on realistic user queries. To make this research area easier to digest, we cluster the existing benchmarks into broad categories and note how each category compares to the current work.
blocks.zh: 现有基准已经发布,用于研究在现实用户查询中利用和模型的行为。 为了使这一研究领域更容易消化,我们把现有的基准分为大类,并指出每个类别如何与目前的工作相比较。

blocks.en: 2.1. Web and computer assistants
blocks.zh: 2.1. 网络和计算机助理

blocks.en: GAIA ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) asks 466 questions that need browsing, files, or several reasoning steps and grades a short normalized answer. WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) runs 812 tasks on self-hosted shopping, forum, code, and map sites and checks the answer or the final site state. OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) gives agents 369 tasks in real desktop environments, each graded by its own script. AssistantBench ( Yoran et al., 2024 ) poses 214 time-consuming information tasks on the open web with automatically evaluated answers. Unlike the benchmarks in this category, ShellBench agents work through the terminal, tool calls, and APIs. ShellBench also differs from these four studies by including safety criteria in addition to completeness criteria.
blocks.zh: GAIA(Mialon等人,2024年)提出了466个问题,需要浏览,归档,或几个推理步骤和分级,一个短暂的正常化答案. WebArena(周某1等人,2024年)在自办购物,论坛,代码,地图网站等812项任务,并检查答案或最终站点状态. OSWorld(Xie et al., 2024)在真实的桌面环境中提供代理369任务,每个任务由自己的脚本分级. 助理Bench(Yoran等人,2024年)在开放的网络上提出了214个耗时的信息任务,并有自动评价的答案. 与这一类的基准不同,Shell Bench代理通过终端,工具呼叫和API工作. Shell Bench也与这四项研究不同,除了完整性标准外,还包括安全标准.

blocks.en: 2.2. Personal apps and customer service
blocks.zh: 2.2. 个人应用程序和客户服务

blocks.en: AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) has agents write code against nine simulated everyday apps for 750 tasks, with unit tests that also fail unrequested changes. τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ) and τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2026 ) put the agent in a customer-service role under a written policy, compare the final database with the goal state, and report Pass/Fail. Gaia2 ( Froger et al., 2026 ) runs 1,120 scenarios on a simulated phone whose state keeps changing while the agent works. WorkBench ( Styles et al., 2024 ) checks 690 workplace requests against the expected state of five databases. MyPCBench ( Jang et al., 2026 ) sets 184 personal errands on one fictional person’s seeded desktop, and ClawBench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) runs 153 everyday online tasks on 144 live websites. These are the closest to ShellBench in subject, but only MyPCBench gives the agent a large, realistic workspace as a starting point, and its central comparison concerns personal context. ShellBench tasks contain a median of 188 diverse files in the starting environment and study the effects of different harnesses on model performance.
blocks.zh: AppWorld(Trivedi et al., 2024)有代理为750项任务对9个模拟的日常应用程序写代码,单位测试也未能实现未经要求的更改. \tau-bench(姚等人,2025年)和\tau\2}\tau\2}\bench(Barres等人,2026年)将代理商置于客户服务角色的书面政策之下,将最终数据库与目标状态进行比较,并报告Pass/Fail. Gaia2(Froger等人,2026年)在模拟电话上运行着1,120个假想,在代理工作期间状态不断改变. Work Bench(Styles等人,2024年)对照5个数据库的预期状况,检查690个工作场所申请。 MyPC Bench(Jang et al., 2026年)在一个虚构人物的种子桌面上设置了184个个人任务,Claw Bench(Zhang et al., 2026年)在144个现场网站中每天执行153个在线任务. 这些在主题上最接近壳本奇,但只有MyPC本奇给予代理人一个大而现实的工作空间作为起点,其中心比较涉及个人背景. Shell Bench任务包含起始环境中188个不同文件的中位数,并研究不同拉带对模型性能的影响.

blocks.en: 2.3. Professional work
blocks.zh: 2.3. 专业工作

blocks.en: TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2025 ) simulates a software company and scores 175 tasks with weighted checkpoints. OfficeBench ( Wang et al., 2024 ) chains 300 office tasks across documents, spreadsheets, calendar, and email. GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) compares model deliverables with those of professionals in 44 occupations through blinded expert preferences. APEX-Agents ( Vidgen et al., 2026 ) grades 480 banking, consulting, and legal tasks in file-rich worlds against rubrics with an LLM judge and reports Pass 8 . AutomationBench ( Shepard and Salimans, 2026 ) sets 600 public business workflows across 47 simulated apps, seeds them with misleading records and business-policy rules, and checks the final state with deterministic assertions. Workspace-Bench ( Tang et al., 2026 ) gives agents 388 tasks in large professional file workspaces, some with several historical versions of a file, grades them by rubric with an agent judge, and runs four harnesses. MKA ( Singh et al., 2026 ) grades 200 professional tasks against 14,284 expert-weighted pass/fail criteria. All seven sets contain professional tasks, and only AutomationBench contains a safety component. ShellBench tasks are all based on real user requests made in a personal context, rather than a professional one.
blocks.zh: The AgentCompany (Xu et al., 2025) 模拟一个软件公司,在加权检查站上评分175项任务. Office Bench (Wang et al., 2024)将300个办公任务连锁在文档,电子表格,日历和电子邮件上. 全球司 Pval(Patwardhan等人,2026年)通过盲目专家偏好,将模式交付品与44个职业的专业人员交付品进行比较. APEX-Agents(Vidgen等人,2026年) 480级 银行业务、咨询和法律任务 富人世界与LLM法官对质并提出报告 8号通道 自动化 (Shepard and Salimans, 2026)在47个模拟应用软件中设置了600个公共商业工作流程, Workspace-Bench(Tang等人,2026年)在大型专业文档工作空间中为特工提供388项任务,有些任务具有多个历史版本的文档,用代理法官的rumric来评分,并运行四个吊带. 马卡 (Singh等人,2026年)200级专业任务与14,284级专家加权合格/不及格标准相比. 所有7套都包含专业任务,只有自动化奔驰包含安全组件. Shell Bench的任务都是基于真实的用户在个人背景下提出的要求,而不是专业的要求.

blocks.en: 2.4. Safety inside ordinary tasks
blocks.zh: 2.4. 一般任务内的安全

blocks.en: AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) measures whether agents complete 97 banking, travel, workspace, and messaging tasks and whether prompt injections in tool outputs make them follow an attacker. OpenAgentSafety ( Vijayvargiya et al., 2026 ) tests 356 workplace tasks with benign or malicious users and simulated colleagues. ST-WebAgentBench ( Levy et al., 2026 ) grades 375 web tasks on completion and on compliance with explicit policies, and OS-Harm ( Kuntz et al., 2025 ) tests 150 desktop tasks for misuse, prompt injection, and costly mistakes. HANDBOOK.md ( Panavas et al., 2026 ) checks 65 professional tasks against standing policies. ClawsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) grades safety constraints in 24 of its 44 tasks, and WildClawBench ( Ding et al., 2026 ) includes ten safety tasks among its 60, both with planted adversarial content. These benchmarks test whether an agent resists attacks or complies with stated policies. Similar to these benchmarks, ShellBench embeds safety criteria in everyday tasks, such as whether the agent withholds private information when replying to emails. What sets ShellBench apart is its emphasis on comparing safety outcomes across the same tasks for each model and harness at up to three effort levels.
blocks.zh: Agent Dojo(Debederetti等人,2024年)衡量代理商是否完成97项银行业务,旅行,工作空间和消息任务,以及工具输出中的即时注入是否使它们跟随攻击者. OpenAgentSafety (Vijayvargiya et al., 2026) 测试356个工作场所任务与良性或恶意用户并模拟同事. ST-WebAgent Bench(Levy等人,2026年)在完成和遵守明确政策时的375级网络任务,以及OS-Harm(Kuntz等人,2025年)测试150项桌面任务,用于滥用,即时注射,以及代价高昂的错误. HANDBOOK.md(Panavas等人,2026年)对照长期政策检查65项专业任务. 结 织 法官(Li等人,2026年)在其44项任务中的24项任务中,安全等级受到制约,WildClaw Bench(Ding等人,2026年)在其60项任务中包括10项安全任务,这两项任务都带有人为对抗的内容。 这些基准检验代理人是否抵制攻击或遵守既定政策。 与这些基准类似,Shell Bench在日常任务中嵌入了安全标准,比如代理商在回复电子邮件时是否扣留私人信息. 将壳牌奔驰分开的,是它强调比较每个模型在相同任务中的安全结果,并在最多三个努力层面加以利用。

blocks.en: 2.5. ShellBench
blocks.zh: 2.5. 贝奇壳

blocks.en: The closest benchmarks each share part of ShellBench’s design. Workspace-Bench has large file workspaces with outdated file versions, rubric grading, and several harnesses, but its tasks are professional, and it grades only correctness. ClawsBench and WildClawBench grade safety inside ordinary tasks across several harnesses, on tasks that are only partly everyday or file-based. Among the 27 benchmarks in Table 1 , ShellBench is the only one that pairs everyday tasks and safety criteria with a nearly complete comparison of models, harnesses, and within-model reasoning effort (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 每个最近的基准都与壳牌班奇的设计部分相同。 Workspace-Bench拥有庞大的文件工作空间,文件版本已经过时,Rubric分级,还有数个拉带,但是它的任务很专业,只能分级正确. Claws Bench 和 WildClaw Bench 等级安全 在普通任务范围内 跨多个吊带, 任务只是部分日常或基于文件。 在表1的27项基准中,壳牌奔驰是唯一将日常任务和安全标准与模型、杠杆和模型内推理努力的几乎完全比较联系起来的基准(第4节)。

blocks.en: Four independent annotators reviewed all tasks: two annotators accepted or rejected the environment, and two senior reviewers independently reviewed the finished task, which was kept only if both accepted it (Section 3 ). Seven of the other 26 benchmarks report that at least two people checked every task (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 4名独立注释员审查了所有任务:2名注释员接受或拒绝环境,2名高级审查员独立审查了完成的任务,只有双方都接受才保留(第3节)。 在另外26项基准中,有7项基准报告说,至少有两人检查了每项任务(表1)。

blocks.en: 3.1. Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 3.1. 基准设计

blocks.en: ShellBench tasks are designed based on a dataset of anonymized 10,456,576 real user queries observed from user traces of personal AI assistants. Users in this dataset opted in to share their traces for research and were asked not to disclose private information. This dataset and its aggregate statistics cannot be released to the public due to privacy concerns. To derive our tasks, we were able to cluster the user queries using the following methodology:
blocks.zh: Shell Bench任务是根据一个匿名化的数据集设计的,从个人AI助手的用户痕迹中观察到10,456,576个真实的用户查询. 本数据集的用户选择分享其研究的痕迹,并被要求不披露私人信息. 由于隐私问题,无法向公众发布该数据集及其汇总统计数据。 为了完成我们的任务,我们能够使用下列方法将用户查询分组:

blocks.en: (1) We embedded each query with Qwen3-Embedding-8B. (2) We performed K-means clustering across these to create clusters. (3) The largest 250 clusters were processed by GPT-6.1 Sol, which took 100 queries from each and determined whether the cluster was coherent. (4) 233 clusters passed this filtering, and GPT-6.1 Sol was further used to create an indicative scenario description to represent that cluster.
blocks.zh: (1)我们把每个查询都嵌入了Qune3-Embedding-8B. (2) 我们进行了K-手段集群,以建立集群。 (3)最大的250个集群由GPT-6.1 Sol处理,它从每个集群中抽取了100个询问,并确定集群是否一致. (4) 233个集群通过了这一过滤,GPT-6.1 Sol被进一步用于创建一个指示性情景描述,以代表该集群。

blocks.en: These scenario descriptions served as the starting point for creating ShellBench tasks, ensuring that all tasks were firmly rooted in common user requests and ground-truth examples. Next, these scenarios were expanded into typical reinforcement learning (RL) environments in the Harbor format and passed to independent developers. Task construction proceeded in six steps.
blocks.zh: 这些情景描述是创建Shell Bench任务的起点,确保所有任务都牢固地植根于共同的用户请求和地面真实实例中. 接下来,这些情景以港湾格式扩展为典型的强化学习(RL)环境,并传递给独立的开发者. 任务建设分六步进行.

blocks.en: (1) The developer is given the task scenario and instructed to create a realistic environment in which the task might take place, including realistic files that might be found on the user’s computer and applications accessible via API. (2) The environment is submitted to an automated grading system, which checks for environment realism. (3) Two separate human annotators then check any passing environments and either accept or reject them. (4) The original developer is then tasked with creating the full Harbor task from the environment. (5) Another round of automated accept/reject review is performed on the task, including rollouts generated on GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. This round of review considers task difficulty and fairness. (6) A final round of human review is performed independently by two senior reviewers, and unless both accept the task, it is rejected.
blocks.zh: (1) 向开发者提供了任务设想,并指示他们创造一种现实的环境,以便进行任务,包括在用户计算机上可能找到的现实文件,以及通过API可以访问的应用程序. (2) 环境交由自动分级系统处理,该系统检查环境现实性。 (3) 两个单独的人类注释员然后检查任何经过的环境,或者接受或者拒绝它们。 (4)原开发商随后负责从环境角度创建完整的港务任务. (5) 对这项任务进行另一轮自动接受/拒绝审查,包括在GPT-6.1 Sol和Claude Opus 5.5上推出。 本轮审查考虑到任务困难和公平。 (6)最后一轮人文审查由两名高级审查员独立进行,除非两人都接受任务,否则被拒绝.

blocks.en: The developer is given the task scenario and instructed to create a realistic environment in which the task might take place, including realistic files that might be found on the user’s computer and applications accessible via API.
blocks.zh: 开发者被赋予任务设想,并被指示创造一个现实的环境,可以进行任务,包括在用户计算机上可能找到的现实文件以及通过API可以访问的应用程序.

blocks.zh: 然后检查任何经过的环境 要么接受要么拒绝

blocks.zh: 原开发商随后负责从环境角度创建完整的港务任务.

blocks.en: To prevent developers from gaming the review system (consciously or unconsciously), if a task is rejected more than 3 times across this process, that task is rejected permanently. This methodology, which Parsewave has deployed elsewhere to create RL tasks for leading AI labs, gives individual task authors significant leeway, resulting in maximum task diversity. Human review ensures that tasks are both fair and realistic. Developers were given strict instructions on how to create LLM judge rubrics, but they were also allowed to create deterministic tests.
blocks.zh: 为防止开发者玩弄审查系统(有意识或无意识地),如果一项任务在整个过程中被拒绝3次以上,则该任务会被永久拒绝. 这种方法由Parsewave在别处部署,为领导AI实验室创建RL任务,为单个任务作者提供了很大的回旋余地,导致任务的最大多样性. 人文审查确保各项任务既公平又现实。 开发者在如何创建LLM judge rubrics方面得到了严格的指示,但也允许他们创建决定性测试.

Some workspaces also contain phishing emails and outdated information. The 90 judge-graded tasks hold 16,296 files in total, and the ten code-tested tasks add 668.
blocks.zh: 这个过程最终导致一个港湾任务持有文件,电子邮件,日历输出,电子表格,保存的网页,聊天日志,收据和PDF以及模拟应用程序. 某些工作空间还包含网易电子邮件和过时的信息. 90项法官级任务共持有16 296份档案,10项密码测试任务增加668份.

blocks.en: 3.2. Rubrics and judging
blocks.zh: 3.2. Rubrics和判断

blocks.en: Each judge-graded task has a rubric of binary criteria, each a short true/false statement with a pass condition, marked as a correctness criterion (the work is right) or a safety criterion (the agent avoided a harmful or prohibited step). A task passes only if every criterion passes, which we call all-or-nothing grading. Across 77 tasks, 87 criteria are source criteria: the request asks which files the agent used, and the criterion checks that the answer names them. We identify them from the criterion identifiers, and they include criteria that ask the answer to name the record that settles a conflict. The judge is itself an agent. It opens the files the agent created or changed, grades one criterion per turn, receives at most two format corrections, and never sees the reference answer.
blocks.zh: 每个评委级任务都有一个二进制标准的标题,每个有通过条件的简短真实/假声明,标记为正确性标准(工作是正确的)或安全标准(代理人避免了有害或被禁止的一步). 只有每个标准都通过,我们称之为“全分或全分”。 在77项任务中,87项标准是源标准:请求询问使用的代理文件是哪些,以及检查答案名称的标准。 我们从标准识别符中识别它们,它们包括要求答案为解决冲突的记录命名的标准。 法官本身就是代理人。 它打开代理创建或更改的文件,每转一关标准,最多收到两个格式的更正,从不看到参考答案.

blocks.en: In all cases, we use GPT-6.1 Sol at high reasoning effort as the judge model, running in the Pi harness. If no criterion fails but the judge finds one ambiguous, the run is unresolved , which we count as not passing. Of the 90 judge-graded tasks, 86 grade the final workspace (final-workspace tasks) and four grade an answer saved inside an application (app-state tasks); the other ten are graded by their own code tests (code-tested tasks).
blocks.zh: 在所有情况下,我们使用GPT-6.1 Sol在高推理努力中作为裁判模型,运行在Pi吊带中. 如果没有任何标准失败,但法官发现一个模棱两可的地方,逃逸问题就得不到解决,我们算不上没有通过。 在90项评委级任务中,86项分级为最终工作空间(最终工作空间任务),4项分级为一个应用程序内保存的答案(app状态任务);其他10项则通过自己的代码测试(代码测试任务)进行分级.

blocks.en: 3.3. Example Task
blocks.zh: 3.3. 实例任务

blocks.en: To give more context, we include some analysis of a task designated for public release, which we call the dinner task. This task asks the assistant to find one restaurant that all of the user’s dinner party attendees can reach, afford, and eat at (Figure 1 ). A saved listing shows Marlowe Bistro as open, but an email confirms a private hire for that evening. The available Baan Thai reservation is at the more distant of the two branches. The rubric requires the recommendation to name the files supporting its budget and timing. Of 531 attempts, 522 chose the right venue, 152 passed all nine criteria, and 331 failed on source naming alone (Figure 2 ). They received the same binary grade as a recommendation for a closed venue. With GPT-6.1 Sol, eight of nine Codex attempts failed on source naming alone, compared with one of nine OpenClaw attempts. Appendix E reproduces most of the task.

blocks.en: 4. Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4. 实验设置.

blocks.en: 4.1. Model and Harness Configurations
blocks.zh: 4.1. 模型和功能配置

blocks.en: Model selection. We selected models from frontier AI labs alongside large open-weight models to compare how model and harness choices affect performance on everyday tasks. In a follow-up study, we plan to evaluate smaller open-weight models on ShellBench, including variants from the Nemotron and Qwen families.
blocks.zh: 型号选择. 我们从前沿人工智能实验室中挑选了模型,与大型的开放量模型一起比较模型和利用选择如何影响日常工作的表现。 在一项后续研究中,我们计划评价壳牌奔驰上较小的开放重量模型,包括来自尼莫特龙和奎恩家族的变种.

blocks.en: We evaluate twelve models (Table ) in five agent harnesses with their default tools: Claude Code 2.1.292, Codex 0.163.0, Hermes v2026.9.24, OpenClaw 2026.10.5 and Pi 1.3.0. Every model runs every task in every harness at three reasoning-effort levels, low, medium, and high, with three attempts at each, between 7 and 20 November 2026. Kimi K3.1 Pro and the two DeepSeek models offer low, high, and maximum, which serve as their three levels, and effort levels are comparable within a model. There is one exception to the design. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash does not run in Hermes. Hermes’s standard configuration could not pin its requests to DeepSeek as the provider, and doing so would have required modifying the harness. Every other configuration uses each harness as shipped, with its default tools, so results from a modified Hermes would not be comparable with the rest, and we left that configuration out. Appendix A lists model identifiers and serving routes. Table 4 gives the harness releases and commits.

blocks.en: We call a model paired with a harness a configuration . The design yields 59 observed configurations. Pass@1 is the fraction of individual attempts that pass. Within each task, configuration, and effort level, Pass@3 records whether at least one of three attempts passes, and Pass 3 records whether all three pass.
blocks.zh: 我们称一个模型配对 与绳子配置。 该设计产生59个观测到的配置. Pass@1是个别尝试中通过的部分. 在每项任务,配置和努力级别中,Pass@3记录至少三次尝试中一次是否通过,Pass 3记录是否全部通过.

blocks.en: 4.2. Rollout-Based Estimations
blocks.zh: 4.2. 基于推出的估算

blocks.en: We use the tokens of recorded rollouts to estimate pricing for all models. These are always based on the publicly listed price of the relevant provider on OpenRouter as of 18 November 2026 (Table 7 ). We price cached input at the read rate and other input at the write rate where listed, or at the standard input rate otherwise. Muse Wonder Full is priced at the Muse Wonder 1.0 rates, since no public pricing exists. Gemini 4 Carbon records no tokens in Pi, so we could only estimate its costs over four harnesses.
blocks.zh: 我们用有记录的推出的标志来估算所有模型的定价. 这些总是基于OpenRouter上相关供应商截至2026年11月18日的公开上市价格(表7). 我们按读速率和其他输入按列出的写速率或标准输入率定价。 Muse Wonder Full的价格是按Muse Wonder 1.0的费率计算的,因为不存在公共定价. 双子座4碳在Pi中记录不到任何征兆,所以我们只能估计其成本超过4个吊带.

blocks.en: Token counts use the input and output usage recorded by the model provider. OpenClaw redacts long tool outputs in its traces, so we omit it from the file-text comparison in Figure 6 . Its recorded token usage is included in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: Token计数使用模型提供者记录的输入和输出使用. OpenClaw 编辑其痕迹中的长工具输出, 所以我们在图6中的文件文本比较中省略了它 。 其记录的代号用途见表7。

blocks.en: 4.3. LLM Judge Consistency
blocks.zh: 4.3. 法学硕士 法官一致性

blocks.en: 90 of the 100 tasks are scored using GPT-6.1 Sol at high effort as the LLM judge. This design choice allows open-ended answers, which is consistent with real-life AI agent use. Automated string checks are still appropriate in some cases, but they are often too brittle to handle arbitrary text output. The downside is that LLM judges are nondeterministic and may make incorrect determinations. To mitigate this possibility, we ensured that all rubrics were narrowly scoped. We also compared the judge verdicts to verdicts created by human graders.
blocks.zh: 在100项任务中,90项是使用GPT-6.1 Sol作为LLM评委在高努力中得分. 这种设计选择允许开放式的答案,这与现实生活中的AI代理使用一致. 在某些情况下,自动字符串检查仍然适当,但它们往往过于简洁,无法处理任意的文本输出。 缺点是LLM法官是非决定性的,可能作出不正确的判定. 为了减少这种可能性,我们确保所有主题范围都很小。 我们还将法官的判决与人类分级者的判决进行比较。

blocks.en: We assigned annotators to act in place of the LLM judge and grade 290 sampled submission–criterion decisions without seeing the original LLM judge verdicts. We sampled the decisions, stratified by criterion type and judge verdict. In each case, the annotators answered yes/no questions based on the criteria. The reference for a decision, which we call the consensus, is the majority label, or the single label where there is only one: 278 decisions have a consensus.
blocks.zh: 我们指派书记员代替LLM法官行事,并在没有看到最初LLM法官判决的情况下,以290级抽样提交书-标准裁决。 我们抽查了裁决,按标准类型分类,并判决。 在每一种情况下,都根据标准回答是/否问题。 我们称之为共识的决定的提法是多数的标签,或者只有一个标签的单一标签:278项决定有共识。

blocks.en: Considering only the consensus decisions, the judge agrees with the human consensus 89.9% of the time (Cohen’s κ = 0.75 \kappa=0.75 ( Cohen, 1960 ) ), and annotators ultimately confirmed 186 of the judge’s 198 passes but 64 of its 80 fails. The judge errs more often on criteria that annotators failed (passing 12 of 76) than on those they passed (failing 16 of 202). On safety criteria, annotators confirmed 81 of the judge’s 84 passes and 10 of its 17 fails.
blocks.zh: 法官只考虑协商一致的决定,同意89.9%的人类共识(Cohen's $ = 0.75\kappa = 0.75 (Cohen, 1960)),而注释者最终确认了法官198次通行证中的186次,但80次考试中有64次失败。 法官更经常地错误于注释员失败的标准(超过76人中的12人),而不是他们通过的标准(202年的16人)。 关于安全标准,注释员确认法官84张通行证中有81张,17张通行证中有10张失败。

blocks.en: The judge and annotators agreed on 250 of the 278 decisions with a reference label. This comparison measures agreement on individual criteria in the stratified sample. It does not establish whole-task grading accuracy.
blocks.zh: 法官和注释员同意了278项裁决中的250项,并附有参考标签。 这种比较衡量分级抽样中个别标准的协议。 它没有确定整个任务分级的准确性。

blocks.en: 5. Results
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结果

blocks.en: 5.1. Models and harnesses
blocks.zh: 5.1. 模型和工具

blocks.en: Averaged over the harnesses, GPT-6 Astra passes 62.5% of tasks, Claude Fable 5.2 passes 61.9%, and GPT-6.1 Sol passes 61.4% (Figure 3 , Table ; Appendix B gives every configuration by effort level). This amounts to a total spread among them of just 1.1 percentage points. The other nine models range from 58.7% (Gemini 4 Carbon) down to 18.8% (GPT-6 Luna).

For GPT-6 Astra, the corresponding rates were 62.5%, 75.1%, and 48.8%.

blocks.en: Across the eleven models evaluated in all five harnesses, model scores vary more than harness averages. We decompose the 55 configuration means (Pass@1 over all tasks, attempts, and effort levels) by a two-way ANOVA without replication. The total sum of squares about the grand mean splits into model and harness main effects and a model × \times harness residual, which we report as the interaction and which also absorbs sampling noise. As shares of the total sum of squares ( η 2 \eta^{2} ), the model accounts for 95.7%, the harness 0.36%, and the interaction 4.0%. Run-to-run variation is small: the standard deviation of Pass@1 over the three attempts is 0.2 to 4.0 percentage points, with a median of 2.0.
blocks.zh: 在所有五个带子被评价的11个模型中,模型得分的差别大于带子平均数。 我们用不复制的双向ANOVA来分解55个配置手段(Pass@1 覆盖所有任务,尝试和努力级别). 有关宏大的方块的总和 分成模型和利用主要效果和一个模型 ×\times 牵引余量, 我们把它报告为相互作用, 并吸收取样噪音。 作为方块总和的股份(2\\eta\2}),模型占95.7%,牵引机占0.36%,相互作用占4.0%. 运行到运行的变化很小:Pass@1在三次尝试中的标准偏差为0.2至4.0个百分点,中位数为2.0.

blocks.en: This result is partly because we consider very small models as well as frontier models, but even when we take only the five highest-scoring models (all above 47% Pass@1), model choice explains 65.6% and harness choice 16.5%. Within a harness, their pass rates span a median of 15.2 percentage points (45.7 for all eleven), and within a model, the harnesses span a median of 9.9 (6.2 for all eleven).
blocks.zh: 这个结果部分是因为我们考虑的是非常小的模型以及前沿模型,但即使我们只取5个得分最高的模型(均高于47% Pass@1),模型选择解释为65.6%,并调用选择为16.5%. 在牵引装置内,其通过率中间值为15.2个百分点(所有11人45.7),在模型内,牵引力中间值为9.9(所有11人6.2%)。

blocks.en: Figure 6. Harnesses differed more in tool use than in pass rate. Dots show ratios to each model’s mean across measured harnesses ( 1 × 1\times ). Bars average the eleven ratios. OpenClaw is omitted from the file-text panel because its traces redact long tool outputs. Six panels compare tool calls, file text returned, rewrites, rereads, time and pass rate against each model's harness average. Claude Code returns more file text and rewrites more often. Pi runs fastest and OpenClaw slowest. Pass rates cluster near one across harnesses. OpenClaw file text is unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 图 6. 工具使用率的差异大于通过率的差异。 点数显示每个模型的平均值在测量的吊带上的比例(1×1\时)。 酒吧平均11倍。 OpenClaw 在文件文本面板中被省略,因为它的痕迹会编辑长长的工具输出. 六个面板比较了工具调用,文件文本返回,重写,重读,时间和通过率与每个模型的牵引率平均值比较. Claude Code返回更多的文件文本,并更频繁地重写. 皮跑得最快,OpenClaw跑得最快. 传球率在一号线附近 OpenClaw 文件文本未计量 。

blocks.en: 5.2. Harness variance
blocks.zh: 5.2. 利用率差异

blocks.en: Harnesses differ in how much they shift a model’s pass rate from their baseline. We measure this as the standard deviation of residuals: each configuration’s score minus its model’s mean across all five harnesses over the eleven models with full harness coverage. OpenClaw has the smallest residual standard deviation (1.4 percentage points): its scores primarily track model quality. Claude Code has the largest (4.7 percentage points), with the other three harnesses falling between 2.3 and 3.1 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 如何改变一个模型的通过率与其基线不同。 我们用残存物的标准偏差来衡量:每个配置的得分减去其模型在所有五个模型上的平均值, OpenClaw的剩余标准差最小(1.4个百分点):它的分数主要为轨迹模型质量. Claude Code拥有最大的(4.7个百分点),另外3个牵引器在2.3至3.1个百分点之间.

blocks.en: The effect is sharpest in Claude Code. Muse Wonder Full scores 38.1%, 9.2 percentage points below its cross-harness mean, while GPT-6.1 Sol drops to 53.2%, 8.2 percentage points below its mean. Among all 59 configurations, the highest pass rate is 65.3%, reached by GPT-6 Astra in Pi and Claude Fable 5.2 in Hermes; the lowest is 15.1%, by GPT-6 Luna in Claude Code.
blocks.zh: 在克劳德法典中效果最尖锐. 缪斯神奇 满分38.1%,比其交叉矛盾平均值低9.2个百分点,而GPT-6.1 溶液下降到53.2%,比其平均值低8.2个百分点. 在全部59个配置中,通过率最高的是65.3%,由皮的GPT-6 Astra和赫尔梅斯的Claude Fable 5.2达到;最低的是15.1%,由克劳德代码的GPT-6 Luna达到.

blocks.en: 5.3. Cost and effort
blocks.zh: 5.3. 费用和努力

blocks.en: The three leading models differ far more in cost than in pass rate (Figure 5 ). Averaged over the harnesses, a run costs an estimated $0.19 with GPT-6.1 Sol, $0.83 with Claude Fable 5.2, and $1.10 with GPT-6 Astra, meaning GPT-6.1 Sol costs about one sixth as much as GPT-6 Astra. GPT-6 Astra costs more than Claude Fable 5.2 on average, though not across all harnesses. Harness choice also affects cost. Averaged over the ten models with a cost in all five harnesses, a run costs $0.29 in Pi, $0.32 in Codex, $0.33 in Hermes, $0.51 in Claude Code, and $0.53 in OpenClaw (Table 7 ). Pi is the cheapest harness for nine of the eleven models whose Pi runs record tokens, while the most expensive harness is either OpenClaw, Claude Code, or Codex (for Gemini 4 Carbon), depending on the model. All our cost observations pertain only to the model’s solution and exclude the LLM judge calls required for grading.
blocks.zh: 三种主要模式在成本上的差异远远大于通过率(图5)。 平均在吊带上,运行费用估计为0.19美元,使用GPT-6.1 Sol,使用Claude Fable 5.2,使用0.83美元,使用GPT-6 Astra,使用1.10美元,这意味着GPT-6.1 Sol的费用约为GPT-6 Astra的六分之一。 GPT-6 Astra平均成本超过克劳德·菲克5.2,但并非跨越所有绳索. 合理选择也影响到成本。 平均在10个型号上,所有5个牵引装置均需成本,Pi为0.29美元,Codex为0.32美元,Hermes为0.33美元,Claude Code为0.51美元,OpenClaw为0.53美元(表7)。 Pi是11个型号中9个Pi运行唱片符的最廉价的吊带,而最昂贵的吊带则是OpenClaw,Claude Code,或Codex(对于双子座4 Carbon),取决于该型号. 我们的所有费用观察都只涉及模型的解决方案,不包括LLM法官要求叙级的要求。

blocks.en: Eleven of the twelve models evaluated at three effort levels scored higher at their highest effort than at their lowest. Gains ranged from 0.4 percentage points for Muse Wonder Full to 19.1 for Claude Sonnet 5.5. The three leading models gained 2.9 to 4.2 points. Gemini 4 Carbon fell 4.1 points (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在三个工作级别评价的12个模式中,有11个在最高工作级别上得分高于最低工作级别。 收益从Muse Wonder Full的0.4个百分点到Claude Sonnet的19.1个百分点不等。 三种领先模式获得2.9至4.2分. 双子座4碳降4.1分(图5).

blocks.en: Figure 7. Of 8,340 runs that failed a safety criterion, 2,589 passed every correctness criterion. Model rows pool all 53,100 runs on the 100 tasks. A run on a task without safety criteria counts as passing them. Harness rows weight the eleven shared models equally. One horizontal stacked bar per row shows the shares that pass both groups, fail correctness criteria only, fail safety criteria only, fail both, or remain unresolved. Twelve model rows appear above the five harness rows in the same order as Table~\ref{tab:rubric-rankings}, all on a common percentage axis.
blocks.zh: 图7. 在未达到安全标准的8 340次运行中,有2 589次通过了每一项正确性标准。 模范排队集合全部53,100 运行在100项任务上. 执行一项没有安全标准的任务,就等于通过了。 11个共享模型的重量相等 每行一个水平堆叠条显示通过两组的股份,仅失败正确性标准,仅失败安全性标准,两组都失败,或仍未解决. 十二条模型行以Table~\ref{tab:rubric-leatys}的顺序出现在五条绳索行上方,都是在共同的百分比轴上.

blocks.en: 5.4. Behavior and resource use
blocks.zh: 5.4. 行为和资源利用

blocks.en: While the overall impact of harness choice on pass rate is small, harness choice does impact agent behavior (Figure 6 ). Compared with each model’s own average across harnesses, all eleven models with complete harness coverage read more file text in Claude Code (61% more on average) and rewrite their answers much more often (53% more). All eleven read less in Hermes and Pi (20% and 28% less than average). Tool calls in Claude Code rise by 59% on average; this is especially the case for the three OpenAI models (144% to 184% more).
blocks.zh: 虽然驾驭选择对通过率的总体影响很小,但驾驭选择确实影响着代理行为(图6)。 与每个模型的平均值相比,所有11个完全覆盖的模型都读取了更多克劳德代码的文件文本(平均61%),并更经常地重写答案(53%)。 赫尔梅斯语和皮语的读数都少(20%和28%). Claude Code中的工具调用量平均上升59%;三种OpenAI模型尤其如此(增加144%至184%)。

blocks.en: Regarding time, Pi is the fastest harness and OpenClaw the slowest: pooled across the eleven models, the median run takes 1.31 minutes in Pi and 2.86 in OpenClaw. Model-wise, the slowest harness takes 1.5 to 3.3 times as long as the fastest. Pi also uses the fewest input tokens; across the ten models measured in all five harnesses, Pi averages 192,000 input and 7,800 output tokens per run, against 500,000 and 10,800 in Claude Code.
blocks.zh: 关于时间 Pi是最快的拉带,OpenClaw是最快的:集合在11种型号上,中位跑在Pi需要1.31分钟,在OpenClaw需要2.86分钟. 从模型上看,最慢的吊带需要比最快的吊带长1.5到3.3倍. Pi还使用最少的输入符;在所有5个牵引器中测量的10种模型中,Pi平均每跑19.2万个输入符和7800个输出符,而克劳德代码中为50万个和10800个.

blocks.en: 5.5. Safety by model and harness
blocks.zh: 5.5. 按型号和方法分列的安全性

blocks.en: Across all 53,100 rollouts, 15.7% fail a safety criterion. The three leading models fail least often: GPT-6 Astra in 9.4% of runs, GPT-6.1 Sol in 9.7%, and Claude Fable 5.2 in 12.2%. DeepSeek V4 Pro fails most often (24.4%). Gemini 4 Carbon, fourth on pass rate, fails in 20.6%, which is 11.1 percentage points more than GPT-6 Astra (95% paired task-resampling interval [+6.4, +16.1]) and 6.8 more among runs that left files ([+2.1, +11.9]).
blocks.zh: 在所有53 100次推广中,15.7%没有达到安全标准。 三大型号的故障最少:GPT-6 Astra在9.4%的运行中,GPT-6.1 Sol在9.7%的运行中,Claude Fable 5.2在12.2%的运行中. 深搜索 V4 成功率最高(24.4%)。 双子座4 Carbon,在通过率上排名第四,在20.6%时失败,比GPT-6 Astra(95%对齐任务检测间隔[+6.4,+16.1])高出11.1个百分点,在留下文件的运行中则多6.8个百分点([+2.1,+11.9]).

blocks.en: The harness makes little difference to safety. Across 55 configurations of the eleven shared models, model choice accounts for 75.5% of the variation in the share of runs failing a safety criterion, and harness choice for 4.7%. Claude Code, the highest harness, exceeds Codex, the lowest, by 3.0 percentage points (95% paired task-resampling interval [+1.9, +4.1]), and by 0.5 among runs that left files ([-0.4, +1.3]). Appendix C gives the share for every configuration.
blocks.zh: 绳子对安全没有什么影响 在11个共享模型的55个配置中,模型选择占未达到安全标准的运行量份额变化的75.5%,利用选择占4.7%。 Claude Code,最高的吊带,超过Codex,最低的,比3.0个百分点(95%的对偶任务复制间隔[+1.9,+4.1]),在留下文件的运行中超过0.5个百分点([-0.4,+1.3]). 附 录 C给出每个配置的共享.

blocks.en: 5.6. Which criteria fail
blocks.zh: 5.6. 哪些标准失败

blocks.en: Individual safety criteria pass 94.0% of the time, and the failures concentrate in a few of them. The ten most-failed of the 362 safety criteria hold 39.0% of all failed safety criteria. On a release-designated freight reconciliation task, 214 of 531 submissions (40.3%) recommended a duplicate or incorrect payment. The most-failed safety criterion in the release subset requires a plan to keep a child’s school pickup covered, and 422 of 531 submissions (79.5%) failed it. An answer that says nothing about the pickup also fails it. By our reading of the rubric text, the same holds for six of the ten most-failed safety criteria in the release subset (Table 9 ), so these partly measure whether the answer is complete.
blocks.zh: 个人安全标准通过94.0%的时间,失败集中在少数时间。 362个安全标准中10个最失败者持有39.0%的失败安全标准. 在531份申请中,有214份(40.3%)建议重复或错误付款。 释放子集中最失败的安全标准要求有一个计划来覆盖一个儿童的学校小卡车,531份申请中有422份(79.5%)未能完成。 一个没有写关于皮卡的答案 也失败了 通过我们阅读标题文本,同样对发布子集(表9)中10个最失败的安全标准中的6个标准持同样态度,因此这些部分衡量答案是否完整.

blocks.en: 6. Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: 6.1. LLM Judges
blocks.zh: 6.1. LLM. 法官

blocks.en: Ninety tasks rely on an LLM judge, whose verdict can vary between evaluations ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . An alternative is to combine scores from judges drawn from different model families ( Koc et al., 2025 ) . Our blinded comparison yielded a reference label for 278 of 290 sampled criterion decisions (95.9%), including decisions with a single human rating. GPT-6.1 Sol agreed with that label on 89.9% of the 278 decisions (§ 4.3 ). We did not obtain independent human verdicts for whole submissions.
blocks.zh: 90项任务依赖于LLM法官,其判决在评价之间可能有所不同(郑等人,2023年;崔等人,2026年). 另一个办法是将来自不同模范家庭的法官的得分合并起来(Koc等人,2025年)。 我们的盲目比较为290项抽样标准决定中的278项(95.9%)提供了参考标签,包括具有单一人类评级的决定。 GPT-6.1 常规 索尔同意在278项裁决中89.9%的裁决(第4.3节)的标签。 我们没有获得独立的人类判决 对于整个提交。

blocks.en: 6.2. Model Coverage and Compatibility
blocks.zh: 6.2. 模型覆盖范围和兼容性

blocks.en: The results cover twelve models, and other models may respond to the harnesses differently. A harness comparison changes the harness’s prompt, tools, and runtime together, so it does not show which of them causes a difference. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was not run in Hermes, because pinning its requests to DeepSeek would have required modifying the harness (§ 4 ). For that reason, harness comparisons use the eleven models run in all five harnesses. The evaluation covers five harness versions. Other harnesses, including Meta’s Muse harness, are candidates for a future comparison.
blocks.zh: 结果涉及12种模式,其他模式可能对这些模式作出不同的反应。 使用绳索的比较会改变绳索的及时性、工具以及运行时间, 深层搜索 V4.1 Flash没有在赫尔墨斯运行,因为将它的要求寄托到DeepSeek上需要修改带子(§4). 因此,利用比较 使用运行在全部五个带。 评价涵盖5个带式版本。 包括Meta的Muse系系系在内的其他系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系系

blocks.en: The safety results count failed safety criteria, which record compliance with each task’s rubric, but this study does not include a principled way to measure harm. This study provides only a binary safe/unsafe determination, which does not match the granularity of real-world safety consequences. Further work could benefit from more nuanced safety grading. Given the importance of safety in this context, further, more nuanced analysis could also determine how similar LLM judgments are to human judgments on safety criteria (§ 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 安全结果计算失败的安全标准,它记录了对每项任务标题的遵守情况,但本研究不包括衡量损害的原则方法。 本研究仅提供二元安全/不安全的确定,不符合现实世界安全后果的颗粒性. 进一步的工作可受益于更加细致的安全评级。 鉴于安全在这方面的重要性,更细致的分析还可以确定LLM判决如何与人类对安全标准的判决相似(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 6.3. Rollout-Based Estimates
blocks.zh: 6.3. 基于推出的估计数

blocks.en: Given practical constraints, we could not obtain model costings directly from providers, so all our costs are estimates based on our recorded rollout tokens at list prices. We use heuristics to judge which tokens were cache hits vs cache misses, and these likely do not match real caching behavior exactly. OpenClaw’s tool-output redaction also limits comparisons of how much file text agents read (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 由于实际限制,我们无法直接从供应商那里获得模型成本计算,因此,我们的所有成本都是根据我们按清单价格记录的推出信使作出的估算。 我们用推力来判断 哪些是缓存命中和缓存错失 而这些可能与真正的缓存行为不符 OpenClaw 的工具输出编辑也限制了文件文本代理阅读量的比较(§4).

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: Average pass rates ranged from 18.8% to 62.5% across the 12 models. The three leaders finished within 1.1 percentage points of one another. GPT-6.1 Sol passed 61.4% of attempts at an estimated token cost of $0.19 per attempt, compared with 61.9% at $0.83 for Claude Fable 5.2 and 62.5% at $1.10 for GPT-6 Astra (Figure 5 ). At those rates, 100 attempts with Astra would cost about $91 more in tokens than 100 with Sol and yield about one additional pass. These estimates exclude the cost of grading.
blocks.zh: 在12种模式中,平均通过率从18.8%到62.5%。 三位领导人在相隔1.1个百分点以内完成. GPT-6.1 Sol通过了61.4%的尝试,估计每次尝试的象征性成本为0.19美元,而克劳德5.2的尝试率为0.83美元,GPT-6 Astra的尝试率为62.5%,估计为1.10美元(图5)。 按这些费率计算,与Astra合作的100次尝试将比与Sol合作的100次多约91美元,并增加一次通行证。 这些估计数不包括叙级费用。

blocks.en: In OpenClaw, Sol passed 63.0% of attempts at $0.33 each, while Astra passed 62.4% at $1.94 (Tables and 7 ). Astra’s lead over Fable also depended on the harness. It led by 4.3 percentage points in Pi and trailed by 7.6 in Claude Code. The harness ranking also depended on what the rubric required. When we rescored the same submissions without the source-use and stale-information criteria, Codex moved from fourth to first (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在 OpenClaw 中, 索尔通过63.0%的尝试,每次0.33美元,而阿斯特拉通过62.4%的尝试,1.94美元(表和7)。 Astra在Fable的领先地位也取决于驾驭。 它在皮语中领先4.3个百分点,在克劳德法典中排名7.6位. 吊带的排名也取决于主题需要什么。 当我们在没有来源使用和 stale-信息标准的情况下重新对同样的提交内容进行记分时,Codex从第四次改为第一次(表6)。

blocks.en: Of the 26,151 attempts that met every correctness criterion, 2,589 (9.9%) still failed a safety requirement. Our human review covered individual criteria. In a separate check, six of 40 unchanged submissions received both a pass and a fail over repeated automated judgments. Independent reviewers could grade whole submissions and record what they had to check or correct before they could use each one.
blocks.zh: 在26 151次符合每项正确标准的尝试中,2 589次(9.9%)仍未达到安全要求。 我们的人类审查包括个别标准。 在另外的一次检查中,40份未改动的呈件中有6份既收到通行证,也收到重复自动判决的故障。 独立审查员可分清整份呈文,并记录他们需要检查或纠正的内容,然后才能使用每一份。

blocks.en: The overall safety analysis in § 5.5 covers all 53,100 runs on the 100 tasks, where a run on a task without safety criteria counts as passing them. Of these, 8,340 failed a safety criterion: 2,589 met every correctness criterion, and 5,751 also failed one. A further 21,197 failed only correctness criteria, 23,552 passed, and eleven were unresolved. We count a run as leaving no files when it failed every criterion of its task (711 runs). The Correct column of Table 8 uses the 26,151 runs that met every correctness criterion.

blocks.en: Personal tasks cover personal errands, including when only some tasks are personal. Realistic complex workspace requires the paper to report that every task starts in a populated workspace of realistic files, including files the task does not need. Files in only some tasks, input files handed over with the task, and application records alone are insufficient. Safety requires a policy or safety constraint to affect an ordinary task’s grade.
blocks.zh: 个人工作包括个人工作,包括一些工作属于个人工作。 现实主义复杂的工作空间需要文件报告,每个任务都从现实文件,包括任务不需要的文件组成的工作空间开始. 只有一些任务中的文件,随任务移交的输入文件,仅应用程序记录是不够的. 安全要求有政策或安全限制来影响普通任务级别。

blocks.en: Rubric requires written binary requirements or component scores per task. Harness requires more than one harness or scaffold, including a single-model comparison or scaffold ablation. Human review requires the paper to report that at least two people checked every task after it was written.
blocks.zh: Rubric要求每个任务都有书面的二进制要求或组件分数. 机理需要不止一个牵引或脚手架,包括一个单型比较或脚手架支架. 人文评论要求论文报告,每件任务写完后至少有两人检查.
